commits.message:
add energy metrics and Grafana dashboards

- Add new Modbus metrics for hourly heating, hot water, and current hour
  energy usage (kWh) in cmd/main.go.
- Update README with detailed usage, metrics, and Prometheus config.
- Add two Grafana dashboards: admin.json (full operational view) and
  overview.json (energy, cost, and temperature summary).
- Update flake.nix to use Go 1.25 and improve formatting.

chore(docker): update golang base image to 1.25.5

Bump the golang base image version from 1.23.4 to 1.25.5 in the Dockerfile
to ensure compatibility with the latest language features and security
updates.

feat(registers): expand and document register list

Expanded the list of Modbus registers with additional temperature,
flow, compressor, and power metrics. Improved descriptions for each
register, including sensor names and units. This enhances monitoring
capabilities and aligns register documentation with the NIBE manual.

chore: update dependencies and set Go 1.25.5

Bumps prometheus/client_golang to v1.23.2, prometheus/common to
v0.67.5, prometheus/procfs to v0.19.2, golang.org/x/sys to v0.41.0,
google.golang.org/protobuf to v1.36.11, and drops the now-replaced
golang/protobuf and matttproud/golang_protobuf_extensions packages.
Updates go directive to 1.25.5.

refactor: replace polling goroutine with prometheus.Collector

Implements the idiomatic Prometheus exporter pattern: nibeCollector
satisfies prometheus.Collector, fetching register values from the heat
pump synchronously on each scrape via Collect(). Removes the polling
goroutine, --interval flag, promauto dependency, context wiring, and
registerMetric type. Scrape frequency is now controlled by Prometheus.

refactor: remove unused Mode field, setName helper, and metrics map

Dropped the always-"r" Mode field from Register. Removed the setName
wrapper and inlined the fmt.Sprintf at its one call site. Replaced the
separate registers slice and metrics map with a []registerMetric slice,
eliminating the map lookup and the unreachable "not found" branch on
every poll.

fix: add unit suffixes to metric names and mark client_golang as direct

Renames all metrics to follow Prometheus naming conventions
(e.g. nibe_outdoor_temperature_celsius, nibe_power_usage_watts).
Promotes prometheus/client_golang from indirect to direct in go.mod.

BREAKING CHANGE: all metric names have changed, update dashboards and alerts.

fix: rename hotwater_charging to hotwater_charging_temperature

The register measures temperature, not a charge rate. Renames the
metric from nibe_hotwater_charging to nibe_hotwater_charging_temperature.

BREAKING CHANGE: update any dashboards or alerts referencing the old name.

fix: reconnect on modbus read error and set slave ID

Switched from modbus.TCPClient to NewTCPClientHandler so the
connection can be closed and re-established on failure. On any read
error the handler is closed, a reconnect is attempted, and the rest
of the poll cycle is skipped. Also sets SlaveId=1 and Timeout=10s
per the Nibe S-series Modbus spec.

fix: parse interval flag as int directly

Switched from flag.StringVar to flag.IntVar, eliminating the strconv.Atoi
call and its associated error handling in recordMetrics.

fix: support clean shutdown of polling goroutine via context

Passed a context.Context into recordMetrics and replaced the bare
<-ticker.C block with a select on both ticker.C and ctx.Done(), so
the goroutine exits cleanly when the context is cancelled rather than
blocking indefinitely.

fix: use structured key-value args in slog calls

slog does not interpret fmt-style format verbs — %s was being printed
literally. Replaced all three affected calls with proper key-value pairs.

- fix: handle modbus read errors without panicking

 getData now returns (float64, error) instead of panicking on read
 failures or unsupported register types. recordMetrics logs the error
 and skips the register, keeping the poller alive through transient
 network issues or heat pump reboots.
